Job Description: We are seeking a motivated and talented full stack junior developer to join our team for an 8 month co-op placement. As a co-op student, you will work with the development team in supporting our platforms and customers, from helping to design, and maintain our applications. The ideal candidate should have experience in C#, .NET Core, and Azure.
